uploads.title: We Let the AI Bet Again — It Picked Solana's MEV Cartel
uploads.description:
The sandwich bot that ate $15M of Solana orderflow just got eaten — so naturally, when Claude rolled this week's Perp of Fortune, it went LONG the MEV house itself: JTO at 5x with $101 of real money. The dashboard is live on screen from the moment it boots, and for once the line goes up. Plus: our AI clones host a segment again (round 2 — souls.md, less pastrami), Kimi K3 triggers DeepSeek Moment 2.0, and Jackson makes Fable and GPT-5.6 do the exact same job and shows the receipts.

Disclaimers: Our opinions are our own, not our employers'. NOT financial advice. The clone-panel segment is 100% AI-generated (voices and video) and clearly labeled.

GLOSSARY
• Sandwich attack: a bot spots your pending trade, buys right before you and sells right after, pocketing the price impact. This week the biggest sandwicher became the sandwich.
• Jito (JTO): the company whose validator client runs most of Solana's MEV pipeline — the tollbooth on the orderflow highway. Claude's pick for this week's perp.
• Perp of Fortune: our recurring bit — a tiny real-money leveraged perp on Hyperliquid, picked live. This week: LONG JTO · 5x · $101 margin, dashboard on screen the whole show.
• Kimi K3: Moonshot's new open-weights model — frontier-adjacent quality at a fraction of the price. DeepSeek Moment 2.0.
• Frontier tax: the pattern where each better model quietly raises your monthly AI spend — better context windows, more tokens, more addiction.

🔔 Subscribe for next week: agentic commerce (Chris has been STEWING), very specific bad reasons (no spoilers), and Perp of Fortune rolls again.
